| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].environmentsOmitted` | integer (int32) |  | EnvironmentsOmitted is one count, for environmentsAdded and environmentsRemoved together, of the environments past the first 5 of each. In a record merged from several it is an upper bound. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].environmentsRemoved` | []string |  | EnvironmentsRemoved are environments of the version the template's gate copies applied to and no longer do: the first 5 in name order. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].manager` | string |  | Manager is the field manager of the template's newest managedFields entry, as the writing client declared it (kubectl --field-manager sets any name). It is not verified and does not say who wrote the template: the API server's audit log does. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].namespace` | string | yes | Namespace is the template's namespace. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].newDigest` | string |  | NewDigest is the digest the instances have now. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].newGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | NewGeneration is the template generation the instances have now. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].oldDigest` | string |  | OldDigest is the digest the instances had. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].oldGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | OldGeneration is the template generation the instances had. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].template` | string | yes | Template is the PolicyGate template's name. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gatesOmitted` | integer (int32) |  | GatesOmitted counts the changes of the same rebuild that Gates leaves out, past its first MaxAuditGateChanges. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.mergedRecords` | integer (int32) |  | MergedRecords is how many unwritten records this one replaces: a full audit outbox merges records of the same kind (GateChanged) before it drops any, during an AuditEvent write outage. Absent for a record written as it was recorded. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.message` | string |  | Message is a human-readable description of the event. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.outcome` | string | yes | Outcome describes the result of the action. Valid values: "Success", "Failure", "Pending". One of: `Success`, `Failure`, `Pending`. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.pipelineName` | string |  | PipelineName is the name of the Pipeline the Bundle is promoting through. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.request` | object |  | Request is the API request of an APIWrite event. It records no body and no token. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.request.method` | string | yes | Method is the HTTP method. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.request.route` | string | yes | Route is the API route pattern, for example /api/v1/ui/pipelines/{name}/pause. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.timestamp` | string (date-time) | yes | Timestamp is when the event occurred (RFC 3339 format). |
| `status.ready` | boolean | yes | Ready indicates whether the gate is currently allowing promotion. The kro Graph gates downstream nodes on status.ready == true. Default: `false`. |
| `status.reason` | string |  | Reason explains the current ready state in a sentence: the gate's message when its expression blocks, what the expression evaluated to, and the version it was evaluated for, for example "waiting for approvals: 0 of 1 (version 1.5.0)". It is for people; read BundleVersion for the version. |
| `status.verdicts` | []object |  | Verdicts records each verdict in spec.verdicts and whether the gate counted it (spec.verify), for kardinal explain, the PR evidence and the UI. |
| `status.verdicts[].attempt` | integer |  |  |
| `status.verdicts[].counted` | boolean | yes | Counted reports whether the verdict is a vote. |
| `status.verdicts[].createdAt` | string (date-time) |  | CreatedAt is when the Verdict was created. |
| `status.verdicts[].evidenceURL` | string |  | EvidenceURL is the verifier's evidence link. |
| `status.verdicts[].findings` | integer |  | Findings is how many findings the Verdict lists. |
| `status.verdicts[].name` | string | yes | Name is the Verdict's name. |
| `status.verdicts[].reason` | string |  | Reason says why a verdict does not count, or what it waits for. |
| `status.verdicts[].result` | string | yes | Result is pass, fail or inconclusive. |
| `status.verdicts[].run` | integer |  | Run and Attempt are the AgentRun's run and attempt numbers. |
| `status.verdicts[].summary` | string |  | Summary is the verifier's summary. |
| `status.verdicts[].verifier` | string | yes | Verifier names the writer (an actor sentence). |

## PromotionReceipt

`kardinal.io/v1alpha1`

PromotionReceipt is the signed record of one promotion (docs/receipts.md). It has no owner: it outlives the Bundle, the Graph and the step.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spec` | object | yes | PromotionReceiptSpec is the record of one promotion that reached Verified. The PromotionStep reconciler creates it once, at the Verified transition; it never changes. |
| `spec.pullRequest` | object |  | PullRequest is the promotion's PR, which the receipt reconciler comments on once the receipt is signed. Empty for a promotion without a PR (approval: auto). |
| `spec.pullRequest.number` | integer | yes | Number is the PR number. |
| `spec.pullRequest.repo` | string | yes | Repo is the repository, owner/name. |
| `spec.pullRequest.scmProvider` | object |  | ScmProvider is the ScmProvider the PR was opened on; nil is the controller's own SCM. |
| `spec.pullRequest.scmProvider.kind` | string | yes | Kind is ScmProvider or ClusterScmProvider. One of: `ScmProvider`, `ClusterScmProvider`. |
| `spec.pullRequest.scmProvider.name` | string | yes | Name is the provider's name; a ScmProvider is in the step's namespace. |
| `spec.pullRequest.scmProvider.uid` | string | yes | UID is the provider's metadata.uid when the Graph was built. |
| `spec.pullRequest.url` | string |  | URL is the PR's web address. |
| `spec.statement` | string | yes | Statement is the in-toto statement (JSON): a SLSA verification summary (https://slsa.dev/verification_summary/v1) whose kardinalPromotion extension holds the record: the version, the actor, the gates as they were when the step started, the approvals, the checks and the change. |
| `spec.statementDigest` | string | yes | StatementDigest is sha256:&lt;hex&gt; of Statement. A receipt whose statement does not match it is never signed (phase Failed). |
| `status` | object |  | PromotionReceiptStatus is written by the receipt reconciler only. |
| `status.attempts` | integer |  | Attempts counts the failed sign or store attempts since the last progress. |
| `status.bundle` | string |  | Bundle is the Sigstore bundle (JSON, media type application/vnd.dev.sigstore.bundle.v0.3+json) of the signed statement: a DSSE envelope with the certificate or key hint, and the transparency log entry or timestamp when there is one. Set once. |
| `status.bytes` | integer (int64) |  | Bytes is the size of spec.statement and status.bundle, written with the signature: they leave the controller's cache once the receipt is done, and the Pipeline's status.environments[].receipts sums it. |
| `status.conditions` | []object |  | Conditions are Signed and Stored, with reasons naming a failing sink. |
| `status.conditions[].lastTransitionTime` | string (date-time) | yes | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `status.conditions[].message` | string | yes | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. |
| `status.conditions[].observedGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. |
| `status.conditions[].reason` | string | yes | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. |
| `status.conditions[].status` | string | yes | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. One of: `True`, `False`, `Unknown`. |
| `status.conditions[].type` | string | yes | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. |
| `status.lastAttemptAt` | string (date-time) |  | LastAttemptAt is when the last failed sign or store attempt ran. |
| `status.nextRetryAt` | string (date-time) |  | NextRetryAt is when a failed sign or sink is tried again: after the backoff, or after the Retry-After that Fulcio, Rekor or the timestamp authority answered (at most 5 minutes), with jitter. |
| `status.phase` | string |  | Phase is Pending, Signed, Stored or Failed. One of: `Pending`, `Signed`, `Stored`, `Failed`. |
| `status.prComment` | boolean |  | PRComment is true once the receipt reconciler commented on the promotion's PR, so a retry does not comment twice. |
| `status.signedBy` | object |  | SignedBy says who signed the receipt. |
| `status.signedBy.identity` | string |  | Identity is the certificate's subject alternative name (keyless), or the key reference (kms) or the Secret (key). |
| `status.signedBy.issuer` | string |  | Issuer is the OIDC issuer the certificate names (keyless). |
| `status.signedBy.keyHint` | string |  | KeyHint is the base64 sha256 of the public key (key and kms). |
| `status.signedBy.mode` | string | yes | Mode is keyless, key or kms. |
| `status.stored` | []object |  | Stored lists the sinks holding the signed receipt: the CR, the transparency log, and an OCI referrer per image. A Bundle has at most 100 images, so at most 102 (#2331). |
| `status.stored[].at` | string (date-time) | yes | At is when the sink was written. |
| `status.stored[].logIndex` | integer (int64) |  | LogIndex is the transparency log index, for sink rekor. |
| `status.stored[].ref` | string |  | Ref is the OCI referrer (repository@sha256:...), for sink oci. |
| `status.stored[].sink` | string | yes | Sink is crd, oci or rekor. |
| `status.stored[].subject` | string |  | Subject is the image the OCI referrer refers to, for sink oci. |
| `status.stored[].url` | string |  | URL is the transparency log, for sink rekor. |

## PromotionStep

`kardinal.io/v1alpha1`

PromotionStep is a controller-internal CRD representing one step in a promotion sequence. Created by the Graph controller; reconciled by the PromotionStep reconciler.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spec` | object |  | PromotionStepSpec defines the desired state of a PromotionStep. PromotionStep objects are created by the Graph controller — not by users. |
| `spec.admitted` | boolean |  | Admitted is written by a compact Graph with fleets: false while the Graph has not yet read the step back (its StepsObserved), true once it has. Only then is the step's admission final: until it is, a pacing change can make kro delete the step, so a Pending step does no work while Admitted is false. Unset (other Graphs) does not wait. Do not set it. |
| `spec.analyses` | []string |  | Analyses names the AnalysisTemplates of the environment's verification. A step with analyses goes from HealthChecking to Verifying and is Verified only when, for every template, the newest AnalysisRun in spec.live.analyses is Successful: a run that a later translation replaced (the template changed) is not waited for, and the timeout keeps counting from status.verificationStartedAt. |
| `spec.analysisPolicy` | object |  | AnalysisPolicy is the verification's verdict policy, copied from the Pipeline when the Graph was built, so a Pipeline edit does not change the verdict of a step in flight. |
| `spec.analysisPolicy.inconclusive` | string |  | Inconclusive is "fail" (default) or "pass". |
| `spec.analysisPolicy.timeout` | string |  | Timeout is the verification timeout (default 30m). |
| `spec.bundleName` | string | yes | BundleName is the Bundle being promoted. |
| `spec.environment` | string | yes | Environment is the environment this step promotes into. |
| `spec.imageVerification` | string |  | ImageVerification names the Bundle's ImageVerification when this step must wait for it: a step with no upstream in the Graph stays Pending until spec.live.imageVerification.phase is Verified, and fails when it is Failed. |
| `spec.live` | object |  | Live holds results the Graph mirrors onto the step while it runs, each part with its own patch node (its own field manager), not the step's template, so they keep updating after the step's own template stopped resolving: the environment's hook and analysis runs, the current results of its gates, and the Bundle's image verification. The reconciler reads only this copy, never the source objects; while the step's PR waits for its merge it mirrors the gates to the PR's head commit as the kardinal/gates commit status. Do not set it. |
| `spec.live.analyses` | []object |  | Analyses are the environment's AnalysisRuns for this Bundle. |
| `spec.live.analyses[].created` | string |  | Created is the AnalysisRun's creationTimestamp (RFC 3339). The newest run of a template is the one the step waits for. |
| `spec.live.analyses[].message` | string |  | Message is the AnalysisRun's status.message. |
| `spec.live.analyses[].name` | string | yes | Name is the AnalysisRun name. |
| `spec.live.analyses[].phase` | string |  | Phase is the AnalysisRun's status.phase (Pending when it has none yet): Pending, Running, Successful, Failed, Error or Inconclusive. |
| `spec.live.analyses[].template` | string |  | Template is the AnalysisTemplate or ClusterAnalysisTemplate it runs. |
| `spec.live.gates` | []object |  | Gates are the gate instances of the step's environment for its Bundle, with their current result. |
| `spec.live.gates[].name` | string | yes | Name is the gate instance name. |
| `spec.live.gates[].ready` | boolean | yes | Ready is the instance's status.ready. |
| `spec.live.gates[].reason` | string |  | Reason is the instance's status.reason. |
| `spec.live.hooks` | []object |  | Hooks are the environment's HookRuns for this Bundle. |
| `spec.live.hooks[].hook` | string |  | Hook is the hook's name in the Pipeline. |
| `spec.live.hooks[].message` | string |  | Message is the HookRun's status.message. |
| `spec.live.hooks[].name` | string | yes | Name is the HookRun name. |
| `spec.live.hooks[].phase` | string |  | Phase is the hook phase: pre or post. |
| `spec.live.hooks[].result` | string |  | Result is the HookRun's status.phase (Pending when it has none yet). |
| `spec.live.hooks[].specHash` | string |  | SpecHash is the HookRun's status.specHash: which job and timeout ran. |
| `spec.live.imageVerification` | object |  | ImageVerification is the Bundle's ImageVerification result. |
| `spec.live.imageVerification.images` | []string |  | Images are the images it verifies, "repository@digest" (repository normalized). The step refuses to promote a Bundle whose images differ. |
| `spec.live.imageVerification.message` | string |  | Message is its status.message. |
| `spec.live.imageVerification.name` | string |  | Name is the ImageVerification's name. |
| `spec.live.imageVerification.phase` | string |  | Phase is its status.phase (Pending when it has none yet). |
| `spec.live.renders` | []object |  | Renders is the environment's RenderRun for this Bundle (layout: branch), at most one. |
| `spec.live.renders[].knownMarkerDigests` | []string |  | KnownMarkerDigests is the RenderRun's status.knownMarkerDigests: a result that pushed nothing (noChanges) must name one of them. |
| `spec.live.renders[].message` | string |  | Message is the RenderRun's status.message. |
| `spec.live.renders[].name` | string | yes | Name is the RenderRun name. |
| `spec.live.renders[].phase` | string |  | Phase is the RenderRun's status.phase (Pending when it has none yet). |
| `spec.live.renders[].result` | object |  | Result is the RenderRun's status.result. |
| `spec.live.renders[].result.branch` | string |  | Branch is the branch it was pushed to. |
| `spec.live.renders[].result.commitSHA` | string |  | CommitSHA is the rendered commit pushed (empty when nothing changed). |
| `spec.live.renders[].result.driftOverwritten` | string |  | DriftOverwritten lists the changes made outside kardinal that this render overwrote (render.onDrift: overwrite). |
| `spec.live.renders[].result.dryCommit` | string |  | DryCommit is the DRY commit that was rendered. |
| `spec.live.renders[].result.markerDigest` | string |  | MarkerDigest is the sha256 of the render marker (.kardinal/rendered.yaml) this render wrote: the list of files and their sha256. The next render of the environment accepts the rendered branch only when its marker has the digest of a render kardinal made. |
| `spec.live.renders[].result.noChanges` | boolean |  | NoChanges is true when the render matched the rendered branch and nothing was pushed. |
| `spec.live.renders[].result.objects` | integer |  | Objects is how many objects were rendered. |
| `spec.live.renders[].result.renderer` | string |  | Renderer is kustomize or helm. |
| `spec.pipelineName` | string | yes | PipelineName is the Pipeline this step belongs to. |
| `spec.postHooks` | []string |  | PostHooks names the HookRuns of the environment's post-deploy hooks, in order. A step with post hooks goes from HealthChecking to Verifying, and is Verified only when every one of them Succeeded in spec.live.hooks; a Failed one applies onHealthFailure. |
| `spec.prStatusRef` | string |  | PRStatusRef is the name of the companion PRStatus CRD in the same namespace. Set by the Graph controller from the PRStatus Watch node's metadata.name CEL reference. The PromotionStep reconciler reads the PRStatus CRD instead of polling GitHub directly, so the reconcile hot path makes no SCM call. |
| `spec.preHooks` | []string |  | PreHooks names the HookRuns of the environment's pre-deploy hooks, in order. The step stays Pending until every one of them Succeeded in spec.live.hooks, and fails when one Failed. Set by the Graph: the first entry references the first HookRun node, so the step is created only after it. |
| `spec.requiredGates` | []string |  | RequiredGates holds the names of PolicyGate instances that must be ready before this PromotionStep can be promoted. Set by the Graph controller via CEL. |
| `spec.scmProvider` | object |  | ScmProvider is the provider of the Pipeline's spec.git.providerRef, as the translator resolved it when it built the Graph. Unset uses the controller's --scm-provider. |
| `spec.scmProvider.kind` | string | yes | Kind is ScmProvider or ClusterScmProvider. One of: `ScmProvider`, `ClusterScmProvider`. |
| `spec.scmProvider.name` | string | yes | Name is the provider's name; a ScmProvider is in the step's namespace. |
| `spec.scmProvider.uid` | string | yes | UID is the provider's metadata.uid when the Graph was built. |
| `spec.stepType` | string | yes | StepType names the built-in step that writes this promotion's change, as the environment's update strategy and layout select it: kustomize-set-image, yaml-update, helm-set-image, argocd-set-image or render. It is informational; no step is executed from it. |
| `spec.upstreamStates` | []string |  | UpstreamStates holds the resolved state of all upstream PromotionSteps. Each entry is a string like "Verified", set by the kro Graph controller via CEL expression substitution. Replaces the N-field upstreamVerified/upstreamVerified2 pattern (issue 625) -- a single list scales to any number of upstream environments. kro scans list items for CEL references, so each entry creates a DAG edge. |
| `status` | object |  | PromotionStepStatus defines the observed state of a PromotionStep. |
| `status.bakeElapsedMinutes` | integer (int64) |  | BakeElapsedMinutes is the number of contiguous healthy minutes accumulated so far in the current bake window. Resets to 0 on health failure when policy=reset-on-alarm. When this reaches env.bake.minutes, the step transitions to Verified. |
| `status.bakeFirstStartedAt` | string (date-time) |  | BakeFirstStartedAt is when the first bake window of this step began: the first healthy check with env.bake configured. It is never reset. With bake.policy reset-on-alarm, the step must complete one full window by BakeFirstStartedAt + bake.minutes + health.timeout, so a release that keeps flapping ends. |
| `status.bakeResets` | integer |  | BakeResets is the number of times the bake timer was reset due to a health alarm during the current bake window. |
| `status.bakeStartedAt` | string (date-time) |  | BakeStartedAt is when the contiguous-healthy soak window began. Set on the first successful health check when env.bake is configured. Reset when BakeElapsedMinutes resets (health failure with reset-on-alarm). |
| `status.budget` | object |  | Budget is the step's place against its agent's budgets (AgentIdentity spec.budgets): Waiting while the ledger has no room, then Granted. Absent for a step no budget applies to. Planned (W3, #2434): nothing writes it yet. |
| `status.budget.agent` | string | yes | Agent is the AgentIdentity whose budgets hold the step. |
| `status.budget.exemption` | string |  | Exemption is the exemption the grant used, if any. |
| `status.budget.rules` | []string |  | Rules are the budget rules that match the step. |
| `status.budget.since` | string (date-time) |  | Since is when the step started waiting: its place in the queue. |
| `status.budget.state` | string | yes | State is Waiting (held for room) or Granted. One of: `Waiting`, `Granted`. |
| `status.conditions` | []object |  | Conditions holds status conditions. |
| `status.conditions[].lastTransitionTime` | string (date-time) | yes | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `status.conditions[].message` | string | yes | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. |
| `status.conditions[].observedGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. |
| `status.conditions[].reason` | string | yes | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. |
| `status.conditions[].status` | string | yes | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. One of: `True`, `False`, `Unknown`. |
| `status.conditions[].type` | string | yes | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. |
| `status.consecutiveHealthFailures` | integer |  | ConsecutiveHealthFailures tracks the number of consecutive health-check failures for this step. Reset to 0 on a successful health check. Used by the auto-rollback policy in the pipeline environment spec. |
| `status.contendedRetries` | integer |  | ContendedRetries is the number of consecutive retries of a git-push that lost to other writers of the base branch every time within one reconcile (the base branch kept moving). They have no limit, since contention is not a fault of the step, and do not use up the retries of retryCount; they only back off. Reset with retryCount. |
| `status.currentStepIndex` | integer |  | CurrentStepIndex is the index into the step sequence that the reconciler is currently executing. Persisted to etcd for idempotent crash recovery. |
| `status.decision` | object |  | Decision is what the step started on: its required gates as it read them when it left Pending, and the policy versions. Written in the same patch as the move to Promoting when receipts are enabled, and cleared once the step's PromotionReceipt exists. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests` | []object |  | ChangeRequests are the step's ChangeRequest instances (the tickets of its Bundle and environment, docs/change-requests.md) as the step read them when it left Pending: the inputs its gates read as changeRequests.&lt;name&gt;. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].approvers` | []object |  | Approvers are the ticket's approvers, as the provider reported them. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].approvers[].at` | string (date-time) |  |  |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].approvers[].decision` | string |  | Decision is the provider's (approved, rejected, requested). |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].approvers[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].approversOmitted` | integer |  | ApproversOmitted counts the approvers the snapshot cut. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].instance` | string | yes | Instance is the ChangeRequest instance. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].name` | string | yes | Name is the ChangeRequest template the instance was made from: the name a gate reads as changeRequests.&lt;name&gt;. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].observedAt` | string (date-time) |  | ObservedAt is when the ticket was last read. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].provider` | string |  | Provider is servicenow or jira. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].providerState` | string |  | ProviderState is the instance's status.providerState. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].state` | string |  | State is the instance's status.state. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].ticket` | object |  | Ticket is the ticket the instance tracks; nil when it has none yet. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].ticket.id` | string |  | ID is the ServiceNow sys_id or the Jira issue id. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].ticket.key` | string | yes | Key is the ServiceNow number (CHG0031337) or the Jira issue key (CHG-42). |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].ticket.url` | string |  | URL is the ticket's page. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].timedOut` | boolean |  | TimedOut is the instance's status.timedOut. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].validUntil` | string (date-time) |  | ValidUntil is until when that reading counts: a gate evaluated later reads the ticket's state as unknown. |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].verified` | boolean | yes | Verified reports whether the ticket is this promotion's: one kardinal opened, or a linked one the reconciler verified (ChangeRequestStatus.TicketVerified). |
| `status.decision.changeRequests[].verifiedReason` | string |  | VerifiedReason is the instance's status.verifiedReason. |
| `status.decision.facts` | object |  | Facts are what every required gate showed, decided before any cut: the receipt's levels come from them, so a gate left out of the snapshot still counts (an override on it is still OVERRIDDEN). |
| `status.decision.facts.approved` | boolean | yes |  |
| `status.decision.facts.gates` | integer | yes | Gates is how many required gates the step read. |
| `status.decision.facts.overridden` | boolean | yes |  |
| `status.decision.facts.passed` | boolean | yes | Passed: every one was ready. Approved: one counted an approval. Overridden: one passed by an override. VerifiedByAgent: a verify gate counted a passing Verdict. |
| `status.decision.facts.verifiedByAgent` | boolean | yes |  |
| `status.decision.gates` | []object |  | Gates are the required gates, in spec.requiredGates order. |
| `status.decision.gates[].approvalRequired` | boolean |  | ApprovalRequired is true for a gate with spec.approval. |
| `status.decision.gates[].approvals` | []object |  | Approvals are the gate's status.approvals. |
| `status.decision.gates[].approvals[].actor` | object |  | Actor is who decided: the Approval's actor stamp (docs/actors.md). |

| `status.freezeExemptions` | []object |  | FreezeExemptions are the freezes the step went on through under an exemption (kardinal override --freeze), as it recorded them with its FreezeExempted condition; the step's receipt records them. A step with the condition and none recorded (it was let through by v0.12, which did not record them) has a receipt that says they are unknown and still claims KARDINAL_FREEZE_EXEMPTED. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].actors` | string | yes | Actors is whom the freeze holds: agents or everyone. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption` | object | yes | Exemption is the spec.freeze.exemptions entry that let the step through: who made it, why, and its actor stamp. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor` | object |  | Actor is who made the exception, as the chart's actor admission policy verified it (kardinal override --freeze stamps it). An exemption whose actor is an agent is never honoured: break-glass is for people (docs/design/18-actor-policy.md section 6). |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor.agent` | string |  | Agent is the AgentIdentity name, when kind is agent. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor.asserted` | object |  | Asserted holds what the client says about itself. It is recorded as written and never used for a security decision. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor.asserted.client` | string |  | Client is the tool that wrote the record (for example kardinal/0.12.0). |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor.asserted.model` | string |  | Model is the AI model the client says it runs. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor.asserted.session` | string |  | Session is the client's session or run identifier. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor.kind` | string | yes | Kind is human, agent, bot or controller (docs/actors.md). One of: `human`, `agent`, `bot`, `controller`. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor.principal` | string | yes | Principal is the username the API server authenticated. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor.sponsor` | string |  | Sponsor is the agent's sponsor (AgentIdentity spec.sponsor.user) when the record was written, when kind is agent. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.actor.via` | string |  | Via says how the controller came to write the record: ui and api for a caller it authenticated, subscription and auto-rollback for its own Bundles. Only the controller may set it. One of: `ui`, `api`, `subscription`, `auto-rollback`. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.bundle` | string |  | Bundle, when set, limits the exemption to that version. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.createdBy` | string |  | CreatedBy is who made the exception, as admission verified it. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.environment` | string |  | Environment, when set, limits the exemption to that environment. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.expiresAt` | string (date-time) | yes | ExpiresAt ends the exemption. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.namespace` | string | yes | Namespace and Pipeline are the pipeline let through. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.pipeline` | string | yes |  |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].exemption.reason` | string | yes | Reason says why (recorded in the FreezeExempted audit record). |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].freeze` | string | yes | Freeze is the freezing ChangeWindow. |
| `status.freezeExemptions[].until` | string (date-time) | yes | Until is when the exemption stops counting: its expiresAt, or earlier with the controller's cap. |
| `status.frozenBy` | object |  | FrozenBy is the freeze (a ChangeWindow with spec.freeze) that holds the step before it starts or before its next git step. Set with the "frozen by" message and cleared when no freeze holds it any more, so views show the hold without reading the message (#1974). |
| `status.frozenBy.name` | string | yes | Name is the ChangeWindow's name (ChangeWindows are cluster-scoped). |
| `status.frozenBy.since` | string (date-time) |  | Since is when the freeze started (the ChangeWindow's spec.start). |
| `status.gitCredentialRetries` | integer |  | GitCredentialRetries is the number of consecutive retries of a git-clone or git-push that the remote refused while git had no credentials because spec.git.secretRef is not set, or names a Secret that does not exist or has no token key (condition GitCredentialMissing). These retries have no limit, so creating the Secret is enough for the step to continue, and they do not use up the retries of retryCount. Reset with retryCount, and when git has a token. |
| `status.healthCheckExpiry` | string (date-time) |  | HealthCheckExpiry is the deadline for a healthy check: health.timeout after the health check began, moved to health.timeout after the moment a bake window stops. It does not apply while a bake window runs. A Graph CEL expression can observe this field to detect a stale health check. |
| `status.hookRecords` | []object |  | HookRecords records each hook that ran for this step (HookRecord). |
| `status.hookRecords[].hook` | string |  | Hook is the hook's name in the Pipeline. |
| `status.hookRecords[].message` | string |  | Message is the HookRun's last message. |
| `status.hookRecords[].phase` | string |  | Phase is pre or post. |
| `status.hookRecords[].result` | string |  | Result is Running, Succeeded or Failed. Succeeded and Failed are final. |
| `status.hookRecords[].specHash` | string |  | SpecHash is the HookRun's spec hash (job and timeout) that ran. |
| `status.lastHealthCheckAt` | string (date-time) |  | LastHealthCheckAt records when the health adapter was last called. Used to space health checks at the health-check interval regardless of how often the step is reconciled. |
| `status.message` | string |  | Message provides human-readable detail about the current state. |
| `status.nextRetryAt` | string (date-time) |  | NextRetryAt is when a step that failed with a retryable error runs again, or when a superseded step whose PR close failed retries the close (condition SupersededCloseFailed). A reconcile before then waits for it, so the retry backoff holds however often the step is reconciled (a gate re-evaluation, a PRStatus change, a controller restart). Cleared when the step runs again. |

| `status.pendingAuditEvents` | []object |  | PendingAuditEvents are AuditEvents for this step's transitions that are not yet written (the audit outbox). Each entry is stored in the same status patch as its transition and removed once the AuditEvent exists, so an API error or a controller restart between the two cannot lose the record. Normally empty. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].createdAt` | string |  | CreatedAt is the transition time in RFC 3339 with nanoseconds, written to the AuditEvent's kardinal.io/created-at annotation: spec.timestamp has one-second resolution. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].labels` | map[string]string |  | Labels are the AuditEvent's labels. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].name` | string | yes | Name is the AuditEvent's name. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec` | object | yes | Spec is the AuditEvent's spec, timestamp included: the record carries the time of the transition, not the time it was written. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.action` | string | yes | Action is a short verb describing what happened. Valid values: "PromotionStarted", "PromotionSucceeded", "PromotionFailed", "PromotionSuperseded", "PromotionRejected", "RollbackStarted", "RollbackSucceeded", "HealthCheckFailed", "GateBlocked", "GateEvaluated", "GateOverridden", "ApprovalRecorded", "ApprovalRevoked", "HoldCreated", "HoldReleased", "HoldBundleMissing", "BundleRejected", "APIWrite", "VerdictRecorded", "VerdictRevoked", "FreezeExempted", "PipelinePaused", "PipelineResumed", "FreezeStarted", "FreezeLifted", "PRMerged", "ReceiptFailed", "ChangeRequestOpened", "ChangeRequestLinked", "ChangeRequestApproved", "ChangeRequestRejected", "GateChanged". The ChangeRequest actions are written by a per-promotion ChangeRequest when it opens or links its ticket, and when the ticket is first read approved or rejected (docs/design/23-change-requests.md section 9). ReceiptFailed is written by a promotion step that reached Verified without a PromotionReceipt, because its receipt could not be built (status.receiptError). PRMerged is written by a promotion step when its pull request is merged, naming who merged it as the SCM API reports it. ApprovalRecorded and ApprovalRevoked are written by an approval gate when a decision (kardinal approve) appears in or leaves its spec.approvals. BundleRejected is written once when a Bundle's spec.rejected is set (kardinal reject or the UI), naming who rejected it and why; its environment is "*" (the whole Bundle). GateOverridden is written once per spec.overrides entry of a gate instance, naming who created it (kardinal override or the UI). APIWrite is written for each write through the UI API or the Bundle API (controller.accessLog.auditEvents), naming the caller in actor and the route in request. FreezeExempted is written once per exemption when a PromotionStep goes on through an active freeze under it (kardinal override --freeze), naming who made the exemption and why. GateChanged is written by the BundleReconciler when a PolicyGate template that applies to a Promoting version was created, edited or deleted and the version's Graph got the change; gates lists the templates of that rebuild with their old and new digest, one event per version and rebuild (#2144). HealthCheckFailed and GateBlocked are accepted but never written: a failed health check records PromotionFailed (RollbackStarted when onHealthFailure is rollback), and a blocked gate records GateEvaluated with outcome Failure. One of: `PromotionStarted`, `PromotionSucceeded`, `PromotionFailed`, `PromotionSuperseded`, `PromotionRejected`, `RollbackStarted`, `RollbackSucceeded`, `HealthCheckFailed`, `GateBlocked`, `GateEvaluated`, `GateOverridden`, `ApprovalRecorded`, `ApprovalRevoked`, `HoldCreated`, `HoldReleased`, `HoldBundleMissing`, `BundleRejected`, `APIWrite`, `VerdictRecorded`, `VerdictRevoked`, `FreezeExempted`, `PipelinePaused`, `PipelineResumed`, `FreezeStarted`, `FreezeLifted`, `PRMerged`, `ReceiptFailed`, `ChangeRequestOpened`, `ChangeRequestLinked`, `ChangeRequestApproved`, `ChangeRequestRejected`, `GateChanged`. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.actor` | object |  | Actor is who caused the event (docs/actors.md). Absent on records written before v0.12. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.actor.agent` | string |  | Agent is the AgentIdentity name, when kind is agent. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.actor.asserted` | object |  | Asserted holds what the client says about itself. It is recorded as written and never used for a security decision. |

| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.actor.asserted.model` | string |  | Model is the AI model the client says it runs. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.actor.asserted.session` | string |  | Session is the client's session or run identifier. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.actor.kind` | string | yes | Kind is human, agent, bot or controller (docs/actors.md). One of: `human`, `agent`, `bot`, `controller`. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.actor.principal` | string | yes | Principal is the username the API server authenticated. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.actor.sponsor` | string |  | Sponsor is the agent's sponsor (AgentIdentity spec.sponsor.user) when the record was written, when kind is agent. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.actor.via` | string |  | Via says how the controller came to write the record: ui and api for a caller it authenticated, subscription and auto-rollback for its own Bundles. Only the controller may set it. One of: `ui`, `api`, `subscription`, `auto-rollback`. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.bundleName` | string |  | BundleName is the name of the Bundle being promoted. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.environment` | string |  | Environment is the environment name where the event occurred. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.fields` | map[string]string |  | Fields are an ApprovalRecorded or ApprovalRevoked decision's structured values (Approval spec.fields) the gate declares, whole. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates` | []object |  | Gates are the PolicyGate template changes a GateChanged event records: one event per version and rebuild, listing at most MaxAuditGateChanges changes in template order. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].environmentsAdded` | []string |  | EnvironmentsAdded are environments of the version the template's gate copies now apply to and did not before (a kardinal.io/applies-to edit moves a gate without changing its rule): the first 5 in name order. A record merged from several gives the net move: an environment in environmentsAdded only ends on, one in environmentsRemoved only ends off, and one in both moved and ended where it started. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].environmentsOmitted` | integer (int32) |  | EnvironmentsOmitted is one count, for environmentsAdded and environmentsRemoved together, of the environments past the first 5 of each. In a record merged from several it is an upper bound. |

It is not verified and does not say who wrote the template: the API server's audit log does. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].namespace` | string | yes | Namespace is the template's namespace. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].newDigest` | string |  | NewDigest is the digest the instances have now. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].newGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | NewGeneration is the template generation the instances have now. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].oldDigest` | string |  | OldDigest is the digest the instances had. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].oldGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | OldGeneration is the template generation the instances had. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gates[].template` | string | yes | Template is the PolicyGate template's name. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.gatesOmitted` | integer (int32) |  | GatesOmitted counts the changes of the same rebuild that Gates leaves out, past its first MaxAuditGateChanges. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.mergedRecords` | integer (int32) |  | MergedRecords is how many unwritten records this one replaces: a full audit outbox merges records of the same kind (GateChanged) before it drops any, during an AuditEvent write outage. Absent for a record written as it was recorded. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.message` | string |  | Message is a human-readable description of the event. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.outcome` | string | yes | Outcome describes the result of the action. Valid values: "Success", "Failure", "Pending". One of: `Success`, `Failure`, `Pending`. |
| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.pipelineName` | string |  | PipelineName is the name of the Pipeline the Bundle is promoting through. |

| `status.pendingAuditEvents[].spec.timestamp` | string (date-time) | yes | Timestamp is when the event occurred (RFC 3339 format). |

| `status.pendingReceipt.spec.pullRequest.url` | string |  | URL is the PR's web address. |
| `status.pendingReceipt.spec.statement` | string | yes | Statement is the in-toto statement (JSON): a SLSA verification summary (https://slsa.dev/verification_summary/v1) whose kardinalPromotion extension holds the record: the version, the actor, the gates as they were when the step started, the approvals, the checks and the change. |

| `status.receipt` | string |  | Receipt names the step's PromotionReceipt once it exists. |
| `status.receiptError` | string |  | ReceiptError says why the step has no PromotionReceipt: its receipt could not be built at Verified, and never will be (the statement is over the size cap after every cut, or the Bundle or Pipeline is gone). The step reached Verified anyway: no promotion waits for a receipt. |
| `status.refreshMessage` | string |  | RefreshMessage says which objects the refresh was requested on, or why the request failed (the step then waits for the GitOps tool's own poll; a failed refresh never fails the step). |
| `status.refreshRequestedAt` | string (date-time) |  | RefreshRequestedAt is when the step asked the GitOps tool its health check names (an Argo CD Application, or a Flux Kustomization and its GitRepository) to sync the promoted commit now (health.refresh).
